name: Premier League
european_places_note: League places per competition before cup winners are added; the zones above are the display layout under the pass-down assumption.
extra_ucl_probability_note: Chance that this league earns the extra Champions League place (European Performance Spot) for next season; 0 = not modelled. Set by hand from the UEFA association ranking race.
domestic_cups_note: Set winner to a club name (as shown on the site), its football-data.org id, or "external" for a club outside this league, once the cup is decided; null = undecided (assumed to pass down).
assumptions: The FA Cup winner's Europa League place and the EFL Cup winner's Conference League play-off place are assumed to pass down the table, so 5th and 6th go to the Europa League and 7th to the Conference League play-off round.
A possible fifth Champions League place (European Performance Spot) is not modelled. UEFA decides it in May 2027.
